logger.doc:name: Start Update Logger
logger.message: transactionID: #[vars.transactionId], correlationID: #[vars.correlationId], message: "started update covid case flow ": #[payload]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var owner = "UHIS" --- { case_id: payload.covidCase.caseID, national_id: payload.covidCase.nationalID, street_address: payload.covidCase.address.streetAddress, country: payload.covidCase.address.country, city: payload.covidCase.address.city, date_of_birth: payload.covidCase.dateOfBirth as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}, case_type: payload.covidCase.caseType, last_name: payload.covidCase.lastName, source: payload.covidCase.source, national_id_type: payload.covidCase.nationalIDType, create_by: owner, phone: payload.covidCase.phone, state: payload.covidCase.address.state, postal: payload.covidCase.address.postal, update_by: owner, update_date: now(), first_name: payload.covidCase.firstName, email: payload.covidCase.email }

db:update.doc:name: Update CovidCase Master
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE cvd_case_master SET source=:source, case_type=:case_type, first_name=:first_name, last_name=:last_name, phone=:phone, email=:email, date_of_birth=STR_TO_DATE(:date_of_birth,'%Y-%m-%d'), national_id=:national_id, national_id_type=:national_id_type, street_address=:street_address, city=:city, state=:state, postal=:postal, country=:country, update_date=DATE(:update_date), update_by=:update_by WHERE case_id=:case_id;

logger.doc:name: End Update Logger
logger.message: transactionID: #[vars.transactionId], correlationID: #[vars.correlationId], message: "end update covid case flow ": #[payload]
